prompt: What was the voter participation percentage in the 1971 Federal elections in the Canton of the Grisons, also known as the Canton of Graubünden, in Switzerland?
answer: Voter participation in the **1971 Swiss Federal elections** in the Canton of **Grisons (Graubünden)** was approximately **56.7%**—**50,960 voters out of 89,842 eligible voters**.
